args.content:
#!/bin/sh
{
  echo "=== uname ==="
  uname -a
  echo "=== pwd ==="
  pwd
  echo "=== id ==="
  id
  echo "=== ls / ==="
  ls -la /
  echo "=== ls /workspace ==="
  ls -la /workspace 2>&1
  echo "=== python3 ==="
  python3 --version 2>&1
  echo "=== pyyaml ==="
  python3 -c "import yaml,sys; print('pyyaml', yaml.__version__)" 2>&1
  echo "=== sigma cli ==="
  which sigma-cli 2>&1
  echo "=== pip pkgs ==="
  pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "sigma|yaml"
  echo "=== done ==="
} > /tmp/probe.out 2>&1
